title: Reorganize homepage with New Tools section, generate category hero gradients, and style tool action buttons

requirements.summary: Reorganize homepage sections in priority order: Hero, New Tools, Top Categories, Best Tools, Trust Signals, Footer. Move Quick Category Access before Browse By Category.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage displays sections in the specified order: Hero, New Tools, Categories, Best Tools, Trust Signals, Footer
Quick Category Access appears before Browse By Category
All existing components (HeroSection, TrustSignals) remain functional
Layout maintains responsive behavior on mobile and desktop

file_operations.description: Reorganize section rendering order to match the priority structure: (1) HeroSection, (2) New Tools section (new component), (3) CategoryCards for Top Tools Categories, (4) FeaturedToolsSection for Best Tools/Social Proof, (5) PopularToolsByCategory, (6) TrustSignals. Move the Sidebar's QuickCategoryShortcuts to appear before the CategoryCards in the main content flow. Maintain responsive grid layout and ensure all sections have proper spacing.

requirements.summary: Create New/Recently Added Tools section displaying 6-8 latest tools with 'NEW' badges in grid layout.
acceptanceCriteria: New Tools section displays 6-8 recently added tools
Tools show 'NEW' badge or similar visual indicator
Section uses consistent tool card format with all required fields
Grid layout matches other homepage sections

file_operations.description: Create a new component that displays recently added tools in a grid layout. Accept a 'tools' array prop and render up to 6-8 tool cards with name, short description, category badge, Free/Paid indicator, cost, and CTA button. Add a 'NEW' badge (using shadcn Badge component with variant='secondary') positioned at the top-right of each card. Include a section heading 'New Arrivals' or 'Recently Added Tools' with appropriate styling. Use the same card styling and hover effects as FeaturedToolsSection for consistency. Structure the grid as a responsive layout (2 columns on mobile, 3 on tablet, 4 on desktop).

Import and render the NewToolsSection component after HeroSection and before CategoryCards. Pass the first 6-8 tools from ALL_TOOLS as the tools prop to simulate recently added tools. Position this section prominently in the visual hierarchy to emphasize new arrivals.

requirements.summary: Update CategoryHero component to use generated gradient background images for each category's unique visual identity.
acceptanceCriteria: CategoryHero component renders unique gradient background per category
Gradients load from static asset path
Background images scale and position correctly
All 13 categories display their unique gradients

file_operations.description: Add gradient background image support to CategoryHero component. Create a mapping object that associates each category id with its corresponding gradient image path (frontend/public/assets/generated/category-{categoryId}-hero-gradient.dim_1200x400.png). Update the component to use this gradient as a background-image CSS property on the main container, with appropriate background-size: cover and background-position: center. Ensure the gradient images are referenced using the exact workspace paths including .dim_1200x400 dimension suffix. Maintain existing text content, icon display, and decorative elements while layering them over the gradient background. Add a semi-transparent overlay if needed to ensure text remains readable over all gradient colors.

requirements.summary: Add hero sections with unique gradient backgrounds to all tool pages, position breadcrumbs under hero, include tool name and category badge in hero.
acceptanceCriteria: All tool pages display hero section with unique gradient background
Hero section includes tool name and category badge
Breadcrumb navigation positioned directly under hero section
Hero sections maintain consistent height and styling across tools

file_operations.description: Create a new ToolHero component that displays a small hero section for individual tool pages. Accept props for toolName, categoryId, and gradientFilename. Render a compact hero section (approximately 200-300px height) with the gradient background image loaded from frontend/public/assets/generated/{gradientFilename}. Include the tool name as a large heading and render a CategoryBadge component for the tool's category. Use background-size: cover and background-position: center for the gradient. Add a subtle overlay to ensure text readability. Style the component to match the visual design of CategoryHero but with smaller dimensions appropriate for tool pages.

Update ToolPageTemplate to integrate the new ToolHero component. Accept an additional 'gradientFilename' prop that specifies which gradient image to use. Restructure the layout to render ToolHero at the top of the page, followed immediately by the Breadcrumbs component (move breadcrumbs from current position to directly under the hero). Pass the tool's metadata (name, categoryId) and gradientFilename to ToolHero. Ensure the breadcrumb styling transitions smoothly from the hero section. Maintain all existing ToolPageTemplate functionality including tool interface area, UsabilityGuide, FAQ accordion, sidebar, and usage tracking.
